dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-frequency, irregular light perimeters with a steep gradient transitioning from the dark dorsal pelt to lighter interior centers, particularly concentrated on the mid-dorsal and cranial-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity dark pixel clusters enclosed by the light-colored annuli; a sparse distribution of solid, high-intensity white pixel nodes located primarily at the convergence points of interconnected line segments.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli on the upper dorsal-lateral surface form an irregular trapezoidal geometry, while three smaller structures on the mid-flank form a narrow isosceles triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of interconnected light-grey linear markings form a continuous lattice-like pattern that bridges several macro-annuli along the dorsal-lateral ridge.
